title: Alex Eala keeps expectations in check ahead of Asian Games gold bid

blocks.text: SINGAPORE–Alex Eala is tempering her expectations as she shifts her focus to winning the gold medal at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026. Eala is staying grounded despite being one of the favorites to win as the top seed in the women’s singles draw that will be without defending champion Zheng Qinwen of China. High-profile players such as Kazakh World No. 1 Elena Rybakina and Japan’s four-time Grand Slam winner Naomi Osaka are also skipping the Asiad to play in the mandatory WTA 1000 China Open in Beijing.
